'''Chaz''' was one of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] most notorious [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. The original owner of the moody [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[R-3PO/Legends|R-3PO]], Chaz "accidentally" left the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] at the Rebellion's [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]].
